verdict.rationale: Data-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for a coding-agent orchestrator with cloud workspaces, so the axis applies. The pack has no Conductor training opt-out, no no-training policy, and no data-usage controls. A developer's remark that local messages go straight to Claude Code and the bring-your-own-keys option are adjacent at best and say nothing about model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
